4.1 Pharmacokinetics

Pharmacokinetics describes how the body handles a drug.

ADME: - Absorption - Distribution - Metabolism - Excretion

metadata.document_summary: This report provides an analysis of the pharmacokinetics of a new drug, detailing its absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion. It aims to inform medical professionals and researchers about the drug's behavior in the body and potential interactions.
